name: LethAL Sandbox Order Tests
brief: LethAL R784 fixture: a Writer and a Reader test codeunit for the serve order probe (leg O1).
description: The Writer sets seven kinds of state; the Reader reports each as an Error() message. Only Order Commit Writer commits (R804; a build may refuse a Commit under TestIsolation = Function). Asserts via Error(), no Library Assert. Not for production use, see fixtures/README.md.
